title: School Complaint LLM Negative Transfer and Retrieval Failures: Reproducibility Package
description: Analysis code and derived research artifacts for a controlled study of adjacent-domain instruction tuning and official-document retrieval in Korean school complaint response. The package includes SCB-48, anonymized expert ratings, compact model outputs, retrieval metadata, frozen analysis inputs, and derived results. AI Hub training data, model weights, and full official-document text are excluded.
notes: Code: Apache-2.0. Project-authored data and derived tables: CC BY 4.0. Third-party materials retain their original terms and are not relicensed.
